title: Localize BackupSyncSection's identity-mismatch subtitle instead of rendering sync_orchestrator's raw English reason string
rule: EH-5 / AX-2 (untested by TQ-8 red-first regression, ST-4 area)

evidence.quote:
? 'Signed in as ${identity.signedInEmail ?? 'a different account'}'
                  ' — sign in as $activeEmail to back up this account.'
? 'Signed in as ${identity.signedInEmail ?? 'a different account'}' ' — sign in as $activeEmail to back up this account.'
skip: true, // BUG R-IC11: see test name above

why: sync_orchestrator.dart builds the identity-mismatch degraded reason as a hand-formatted English sentence and backup_sync_section.dart's _buildDegradedCard renders that `reason` verbatim as the card subtitle (only the button label goes through AppLocalizations) whenever identity.isMismatch is true — this bypasses the ST-4 fix entirely, which only strips raw English for the non-mismatch 'stuck outbox' branch via a separate `reason.contains('row(s) stuck')` string-sniff. A Hebrew-locale user who hits an identity mismatch (e.g. after switching Google accounts on a shared device — a real, reachable state, not a hypothetical) sees the English sentence 'Signed in as x@... — sign in as y@... to back up this account.' embedded in an otherwise-Hebrew card: exactly the class of bug this test file's other 4 assertions (L1-L4) exist to catch. backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart's _buildHarness hardcodes `SyncIdentityStatus.matched()` in every one of its 4 tests, so this branch is never exercised and the leak ships invisibly under a fully green suite.
recommendation: Add localized ARB entries (EN+HE) for the identity-mismatch subtitle (e.g. parameterized on signedInEmail/activeEmail) and have _buildDegradedCard's isMismatch branch build its subtitle from AppLocalizations, never from the raw `reason` value; keep `reason` as a log-only/debug field. Add an L5 test in backup_sync_error_l10n_test.dart that overrides syncIdentityStatusProvider to a mismatch state and asserts no raw English sentence fragment (e.g. 'Signed in as') renders under Locale('he'), mirroring the existing L1/L3 negative assertions.
acceptance_criteria: backup_sync_section.dart's identity-mismatch branch subtitle is built entirely from AppLocalizations getters, never from the raw sync_orchestrator reason string.

A new test overrides syncIdentityStatusProvider to SyncIdentityStatus.mismatch(...) and, under Locale('he'), asserts absence of the raw English reason text and presence of the localized Hebrew fallback — this test fails on the current code and passes after the fix (red-first, TQ-8).
mergedFrom: Localize SyncStatusDegraded.reason in BackupSyncSection._buildDegradedCard's identity-mismatch branch
